The '''Adari sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]<ref name="TEA" /> that contained the [[Adari system/Legends|Adari]] and [[Adim system/Legends|Adim systems]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the publication of ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''{{'s}} first draft<ref name="EAA" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology note">According to ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was discovered two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the publication of ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''{{'s}} first draft. As ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' dates this event to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], it can be determined that this manuscript was published in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adari]], expanded out into the Adari [[Star system/Legends|system]]. After [[Mining/Legends|harvesting]] most of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in their home system, they expanded out into other systems throughout the Adari sector. By 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the [[Adarian government]] had come to control the entire sector.<ref name="EAA" />
